Respondent/s =========================================================== Appearance : For the Petitioners : Mr. Prabhat Ranjan, Advocate For the Respondent-State : Mr. Lalit Kishore, Paag Mr. Bishwa Bibhuti Kumar Singh, Advocate For the Respondent Pmc : Mr. Prasoon Sinha, Advocate For the respondent No.8 : Dr. Punam Kumari Singh, C.G.C. =========================================================== Coram: Honourable The Chief Justice And Honourable Mr. Justice Sudhir Singh Patna High Court Cwjc No.14024 of 2014 dt.20-04-2015 2/4 Oral Judgment
texts.facts: This writ petition is filed in public interest with a prayer to direct the respondents herein to enforce the Regulation 2.3.4 of the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011(for short, 'the Regulations, 2011') made under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The petitioners are associations of Oro Dental Specialty Clinics. They state that on account of indiscriminate consumption of tobacco products, large number of persons are suffering from cancer and other related diseases, particularly in the oral region, and after noticing the seriousness of the problems, the Government has brought into existence the present Regulations, 2011. It is stated that though meticulous standards for every food items are prescribed and addition or inclusion of tobacco or any other tobacco products is prohibited, hardly there is any control over the markets. It is pleaded that taking advantage of the inaction of the State, traders are indulging in the distribution and sale of products containing objectionable substances. On behalf of the respondents 1, 3 and 6, a detailed counter affidavit is filed. It is stated that with a view to enforce the standards stipulated under Regulation 2.3.4 of the Regulations, 2011, Patna High Court CWJC No.14024 of 2014 dt.20-04-2015 another set of Regulations have been framed by the State of Bihar banning the storage, sale, distribution and consumption of the Gutaka Pan and other tobacco containing products.
